title: How Accurately Could Early (622–900 CE) Muslims Determine the Direction of Prayers (Qibla)?
description: Peer-reviewed statistical analysis of Gibson's early-mosque qibla data, concluding that under Gibson's assumptions the orientations are consistent with intentional aiming at Petra, with error growing with distance from the target.

cited_by.title: The First Mosques Faced Petra, Not Mecca
